label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is filter string passed to encodeForHTML() at response output (lines 115-120); HTML encoding applied to the complete filter including bar. Alert 2 (java/ldap-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is filter = "(&(objectclass=person))(|(uid=" + bar + ")(street={0}))" where bar = doSomething(param) and param comes from user cookie. Bar flows directly into LDAP filter without sanitization; Base64 encode/decode roundtrip does not protect against LDAP injection (preserves special chars like *, |, ;). Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input extracted from cookie via URLDecoder.decode()
doSomething performs Base64 encode/decode roundtrip on param, returning bar
LDAP filter constructed with bar concatenated: uid=" + bar + "
Filter printed to response with encodeForHTML() applied - mitigates XSS but not LDAP injection
